purpose: Find missing battle-state information, not tune model hyperparameters
validation_note: All seeds reuse the same 10000 labelled battles already explored. These are paired sensitivity checks, not independent untouched confirmation sets.
fixed_model_parameters: same LightGBM and XGBoost as the previous scratchboard
baseline: fold-local corrected baseline and previous selected feature blend, same duplicate-timeline grouped folds
new_hypotheses: departures and incoming HP distinguish preserved reserves from possible unrecorded KOs
HP concentration, observed recovery access, status history and active clocks distinguish equal total HP states
switch matchup improvement and observed hazard entry evidence capture pressure and decision quality
items, levels and HP quantization describe quality or data-source differences
ordered roster state is a separate extraction-order diagnostic, not assumed to be initial strategic intent
a battle-group-cross-fitted auxiliary classifier can transfer recorded P1 KO-versus-switch evidence to P2
observed species-move signatures refine recurring team records
kaggle_policy: No submissions; recommend at most one candidate after local checks
test_policy: No test input or labels used to select new features
